The public-input check (P3)
  & The specification checks two equations; the Rust, the Python and the recursion guest check
  one (\cref{sec:gen-table-pub-transcript-pubcheck})
  & the specification \\
The round consistency equation (T6)
  & The specification lists ``every sumcheck's rounds'' among the checks (\code{08:100}); in both
  verifiers it holds by construction and cannot reject
  & neither: its oracle protocol sends four coefficients and checks (dossier
  \file{gt-table-pub.md}, section 4, item 7) \\
Which coefficient is omitted (T5)
  & The specification does not say; both verifiers omit the linear coefficient $c₁$
  & the verifiers (acceptance test 8) \\
The batching error
  & The specification charges $(ν_{\mathrm{side}} + B)/|\E|$ (\code{05:155}); its own Corollary
  3.9 (\code{cor:idtest}, \code{03:67}) gives $(ν_{\mathrm{side}} + B − 1)/|\E|$. The code
  states none. (The citation check corrected the number of the corollary, which the dossier
  gave as 3.7.)
  & neither: $(B+2)/|\E|$, the tight value \\
Order of JUMP's columns
  & The specification lists $w, b$ before the counts (\code{07:99}); both verifiers put them last
  (\code{tables.rs:689-711}; \code{py:826}). The listing is not presented as an order
  & the verifiers, through leanISA (\code{leanisa-blueprint.md:612-613}: ``\code{Row} is the
  table's column list in the Rust's order''; the citation check corrected the lines, which the
  dossier gave as 611-612) \\
Guard \code{zeta.len() < n}
  & Rust only (\code{constraints.rs:251-253}). Unreachable: every table has at least three push
  blocks, so $μ_{\mathrm{bus}} ≥ τ_{\max} + 1$
  & not modelled; nothing to model \\
Comments in the Rust
  & \code{constraints.rs:24} says the round polynomial ``is sent WHOLE, at four nodes'';
  \code{:265-266} says ``\code{h(0)} is derived''. The code sends three \emph{coefficients} and
  derives $c₁$; $h(0) = c₀$ is transmitted (\code{transcript.rs:63-71}). The citation check
  found two more stale comments: \code{constraints.rs:26} says the verifier checks
  ``\code{h(0) + h(1) = claim}, then interpolate at the challenge'' (there is neither a check nor
  an interpolation: coefficients are read and one is derived); \code{:257-260} says ``Each round
  arrives as the round polynomial itself at \code{nd}'' (it arrives as three coefficients,
  \code{transcript.rs:289-302})
  & the code; but the status repeats ``four nodes'' (\cref{f:table-pub-status-wrong}) \\
